name: USW-Ultra-210W
title: Switch Ultra 210W
summary: Compact 8-port 1G L2 switch: 7 PoE+ out, PoE++ or AC input; 202 W with included 210 W brick.

extra.poe_budget_by_input: PoE++ in 42W; PoE+ in 16W; 60W PoE adapter 42W; 60W AC adapter 52W; 210W AC adapter 202W (at 45°C; 161W/121W at 60°C)

gotchas: PoE budget depends on power source: 202 W only with the included 210 W brick; PoE++ upstream gives just 42 W, PoE+ 16 W.
All ports are 1 GbE, no SFP — uplink caps at 1 Gbps.
PoE+ max per port (30 W) — no PoE++ output for E7/PTZ/AI Key.
L2 only, reduced feature set (256 VLANs, no LACP/802.1X listed).
Requires a UniFi console/gateway to adopt.
best_for: remote camera/AP cluster fed by one PoE++ run
